title: Convergence of Mean-Field Langevin Stochastic Descent-Ascent for Distributional Minimax Optimization
source_version: PMLR volume 267 published original; retrieved exact supplied PDF URL
summary: Exact admissible Gaussian updates contradict Theorems 1-2 with stated explicit constants and the key uniform one-step estimate; local temperature, transport, metric and continuous-time scaling errors also identified.
limitations: General repaired rate not established; no finite-particle or empirical experiment.
No relevant released code identified; no author code executed.
OpenReview attachments unavailable; bibliography/later errata not audited.

problems.location: Theorems 1-2 pp.6-7; A.3 pp.11-12; proof p.22
problems.evidence: J=0 Gaussian test, exact Decimal outputs; even Gamma_j enlarged to 100 gives bound violation.
problems.assumptions: tau=.5, alpha=1,C1=C2=.5,lambda=.1,eta2=.01,eta1=.0005; Mi=0; finite Gaussian initial moments; exact oracle.
problems.counterevidence: Appendix derives slower 1-eta1*tau*alpha factor; Gaussian recursion does converge to discretization neighborhood.

problems.location: Proposition 1/Lemma 1 p.5; Lemmas 6-7 pp.12-14; identity p.22
problems.judgment: Uniform one-step bound false under stated assumptions
problems.evidence: Narrow Gaussian ascent exact gain 1.151... versus lower bound >24.98; equilibrium descent bound negative due missing tau.
problems.counterevidence: All test densities smooth/positive with finite moments; correcting tau alone resolves equilibrium issue but not narrow-Gaussian bound.
problems.repair: Correct temperature and inverse-Jacobian factors; establish density-dependent/uniform remainder or use different argument.
problems.core_dependency: Foundation of elementary discretization proof and main complexity claim.

independent_check.source_and_assumptions: Read Proposition1/Lemma1 p.5, Lemma6 p.12, Lemma7/Eq.(26) p.13 and repeated LSI identity p.22. Same admissible J=0 family; nu0=N(0,1e-4) is smooth, positive, finite-KL and finite-moment. Reference LSI does not impose an iterate Hessian/Fisher upper bound.
independent_check.decisive_check: Fresh exact next variance .0100990025 gives ascent gain1.151255686771924 versus required minimum24.98500025 even with Gamma2=100. Differentiating negative Gaussian entropy yields h''(epsilon)=1/[2(s+epsilon)^2]; convexity alone supplies no upper Taylor constant. Chain rule for pushed density requires (DT)^(-T), absent from(26), so linear scaling changes Fisher by a^-2. At mu0=nu0=rho, printed Proposition1 RHS<=-0.0000375, whereas the Euler variance1+(eta1*tau)^2 gives positive KL.
independent_check.alternatives_and_scope: The equilibrium defect is repaired locally by tau*grad(log mu); the narrow-Gaussian defect survives that correction. Every example has good boundary behavior, so integration-by-parts or singular initial laws cannot explain it. Stronger density regularity with explicit constants or a new discretization estimate could repair the proof, but was not established here.
independent_check.result: Supported Major core proof failure; no general repaired rate certified.
